card.name: Titration in opioid breathing warnings
card.fires_on: Mainly the word piece "ration" ending "titration" in the phrase "proper dosing and titration" in opioid respiratory depression warnings. Also fires on a few other words like "reference" and "diagnostic" after "a".

modes.label: Titration in opioid warnings
modes.description: The ending of "titration" in the sentence about reducing the risk of respiratory depression.
modes.example: To reduce the risk of respiratory depression, proper dosing and tit<<ration>> of Hydrocodone Bitartrate

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Isolated adjectives or hyphens after "a" or in standards numbers, with no shared theme.
modes.example: As a<< diagnostic>> test for pregnancy Hypersensitivity to any

card.plain: It lights up on the end of the word titration in the standard opioid warning about proper dosing.
